reason: The asserted results require mapping and nested list destructuring assignments, including named field bindings and rest captures. List destructuring assignments containing mapping patterns, e.g. [{var1: xVar1}, {var1: xVar11}] = r1.
Mapping constructor spread fields in testVarAssignmentOfRecordLiteral8 and testMappingBindingPatternAgainstOpenRecordInTupleDestructuring.
